_doc: FDA 21 CFR Part 11 / GxP overlay for electronic records and electronic signatures in regulated (clinical / GxP) research. Composed ON TOP of a FedRAMP baseline; does not change partition/region. It lengthens audit-record retention and asserts the Part 11 control catalog. Part 11's core demands — immutable audit trails, electronic-signature binding, and computer system validation (CSV) — are partly platform controls and partly process/SOP controls documented in the vertical; the toolkit configures the platform side and flags the rest for the quality/validation team.
